_meta.title: Watchers - Topolograph
_meta.description: Add and follow OSPF, IS-IS and BMP watchers that stream network changes to Topolograph.

watchers_intro: A watcher runs on a Docker host in your network and streams OSPF, IS-IS or BGP changes to Topolograph.
empty_cards_title: No watchers yet. Pick one to start:
field_name_help: Lowercase letters, digits and dashes. Shown in the Watchers table.
localhost_warning: Topolograph is opened via localhost, which the watcher host cannot reach. Log in again via the IP address or name of this host, then continue.
mark_command: Command ran on the watcher host
http_warning: Topolograph is opened over http, so the token travels in clear text.
rotate_confirm: The current token stops working. Run the configure command again with the new token. Continue?
graph_hint: The graph opens once the first data arrives.
danger_hint: After a token change the running watcher stays disconnected until the configure command runs again.
no_token: This watcher has no token. Rotate the token to get a new one.
delete_revoke_note: The token is revoked first, so the watcher stops sending data. Remove its containers from the watcher host afterwards.
delete_only_hint: Its graphs and events stay in Topolograph.
delete_with_data: Delete the watcher with its graphs and events
update_all_note: All watchers of this type on the host share one installation and are updated together. Host:
update_new_fields: The new version needs these answers:
update_command: Run on the watcher host. The same command with the previous version rolls back.
